items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: For instance Frances -- a lot of the girls that have college educations, their grammar is very bad.

ctx.x: In the world, in general. And I always wanted to be able to speak intelligently when I spoke, you know. And then not having a college education, and all, I used to read books. You'd be surprised what the newspapers can do for you if you read them. You know, For instance Frances -- a lot of the girls that have college educations, their grammar is very bad.

But let me ask, now, you were one of the celebrities of the twenties. If you walked into, for instance, Small's in the twenties, did people recognize -- I'm not talking about show business people, now, the other --
